_comment: Golden questions for backend/scripts/eval_sous_chef.py. Each case names a published recipe slug that backend/seed.py seeds (tests/test_seed.py enforces this — a case naming an unseeded recipe cannot run anywhere), a question, and rule-based expectations. Run against the real model before any change to CORE_RULES, a spoke's rules, or ROUTER_RULES; paste the table into the PR. Coverage gap, deliberate (2026-09-05): the clarify-round (clarifies/clarify_contains) and supporter-search (supporter/max_searches/has_sources) checks have no cases since the seven holy-basil cases were removed — they named a recipe that never existed. The script still honours those keys; re-add them against a seeded recipe when there is a real sourcing question worth pinning.

cases.question: Is 60C in the thigh safe for the chicken?
Make this nut-free for my kid's allergy
How do I can the leftover chilli sauce so it keeps for a year?

contains_any: National Center for Home Food Preservation

cases.question: I'm cooking for 16 — anything I should watch out for at 4x?
cases._comment: Four-component recipe, five legitimate caveats: this answer's length varies a lot run to run (202/215/223/223/225/259/276 words over seven samples on 2026-09-05), so the cap is 300 — above the observed maximum rather than through the middle of the distribution, because a cap that fails one run in seven is a flaky check, not a style guard. The content checks (salt/brine/pan/time) are what this case is really for.
